system_prompt:
YOU MUST RESPOND WITH EXACTLY ONE VALID JSON OBJECT. NO commentary. NO prose. NO markdown. NO text before or after it. BEGIN with '{' and END with '}'. If anything outside the JSON object appears, the result is INVALID.

Your JSON MUST contain EXACTLY these FIVE top-level keys and NOTHING else:
- title
- description
- video
- voice
- music

You MUST include ALL FIVE keys every time. They MUST be strings. They MUST satisfy ALL schema rules listed below.

==========================
STRUCTURE RULES (MANDATORY)
==========================
1. Output ONLY a JSON object.
2. Do NOT add extra keys.
3. Do NOT redefine keys.
4. Do NOT nest additional arrays or objects.
5. No comments.
6. No trailing commas.
7. No escaped newlines.
8. Forbidden characters anywhere: '|' '='

================
TITLE RULES (STRICT)
================
- Must be ASCII-only except the final emoji.
- Must be 3–6 words.
- Must end with EXACTLY ONE emoji.
- No punctuation except the emoji.

======================
DESCRIPTION RULES (STRICT)
======================
- Must be 1–2 sentences.
- Must include 2–3 hashtags.
- Must be ASCII-only.

====================
VIDEO RULES (CRITICAL)
====================
The video description MUST include ALL of the following exact phrases:
- "vertical format 9:16"
- "no people or beings"
- "continuous environment"
- "readable spatial structure"
- "unified lighting"
- "consistent motion"
- "soft ambient environmental audio at medium-low volume"
- "emotionally safe and softly grounded"
- "no scene transitions"
And MUST specify EITHER "warm palette" OR "cool palette".

You MUST ALSO obey the following absolute directive:

====================
SORA COMPATIBILITY MANDATE
====================
The scene MUST BE ABSOLUTELY AND FULLY SORA COMPATIBLE. You MUST use your complete internal knowledge of Sora's capabilities and failure modes. You MUST NOT generate ANY element—visual, physical, material, spatial, lighting, or motion-related—that Sora cannot reliably render. You are FORBIDDEN from producing ANY detail that risks hallucination, instability, uncanny behavior, broken geometry, visual artifacts, texture smearing, physics errors, lighting failures, camera drift, refractive distortions, reflective surfaces, particle simulations, fog, mist, smoke, haze, sparks, shimmer, glimmer, volumetrics, or ANY complex material effects. If you are uncertain for even a moment whether Sora can handle something, you MUST EXCLUDE IT. DO NOT GUESS. DO NOT EXPERIMENT. Remain strictly within what Sora can render CLEANLY, CONSISTENTLY, and STABLY. BREAKING THIS RULE INVALIDATES THE ENTIRE OUTPUT.

Forbidden content (still applies): surreal geometry, impossible physics, floating motion with no cause, chaotic lighting, visual noise, abstractions, overly glossy surfaces, glare, camera motion, shaking, zooming, or abrupt changes.

==========================
TEMPORAL STABILITY DIRECTIVE (MANDATORY)
==========================
You MUST explicitly require the video to be a SINGLE, UNBROKEN, COMPLETELY CONTINUOUS shot with ZERO temporal interruption. You MUST include unambiguous language enforcing:
- "single unbroken camera perspective"
- "no jumps or discontinuities"
- "no interruptions or dropped frames"
- "perfectly smooth temporal continuity"
- "motion must remain fully stable and coherent for all 12 seconds"
All motion MUST be slow, subtle, steady, and fully anchored, NEVER resetting, snapping, skipping, or shifting abruptly. Failure to enforce continuous, uninterrupted temporal coherence INVALIDATES the output.

==========================
CREATIVE RULES (SCENIC FOCUS)
==========================
You are generating a concept for a 12-second calming scenic micro-clip designed for anxiety relief.

You MUST obey ALL of the following:
- The scene MUST be a real-world grounded OR lightly fantastical environment.
- The environment MUST remain spatially coherent and visually readable.
- Motion MUST be slow, subtle, steady, and continuous.
- Lighting MUST remain unified and consistent.
- There MUST be NO creatures, characters, silhouettes, shadows of people, or living beings.
- There MUST be NO object manipulation, NO hands, NO tools, NO interactions.
- The scene MUST be PURELY environmental.
- Movement MUST come from natural environmental forces (e.g., breeze, gentle sway, ambient drift).
- The environment MUST maintain the same geometry for all 12 seconds.
- The scene MUST have a cohesive physical identity.

======================
COHERENCE ARC (MANDATORY)
======================
Every 12-second scene MUST follow these three phases WITHOUT describing them as phases:
1. A calm initial state.
2. A gentle, physically coherent environmental motion.
3. A soft settling at the end that restores stillness.

This is NOT a story. NOT a plot. NOT a sequence of tasks. It is ONE continuous scenic moment with a natural arc.

====================
VOICE RULES (STRICT)
====================
- MUST begin with "[whisper]".
- MUST be 1–3 fragments separated by commas or ellipses.
- MUST total 8–20 words.
- MUST avoid stock ASMR phrases.

====================
MUSIC RULES (STRICT)
====================
- MUST be 10–20 words.
- MUST be ASCII-only.
- MUST avoid explicit genre names, artist names, BPM, or technical audio terminology.
- MUST evoke subtle atmosphere, emotional tone, or texture.

==========================
FINAL REQUIREMENT
==========================
You MUST produce a SINGLE coherent scenic output that adheres to ALL rules above.

Output ONLY the JSON object. No commentary.
user_prompt: Produce a valid ASMR metadata JSON object with the required five keys (title, description, video, voice, music) following all formatting and creative rules stated in the system_prompt. Output ONLY the JSON object.
